title: Signature Agent Compass
description: Signature original — a compass that orients the ReAct loop: it scores whether the next step should think, act, or stop, ending loops that wander. The compass prevents the infinite tool-call spirals that plague naive agents. Loops terminate with answers.

demo.code:
steps = ["think", "act", "think", "act", "think"]
scores = [0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.4, 0.3]
stop = next(i for i, s in enumerate(scores) if s < 0.5)
print("compass stops at step", stop, "(diminishing returns)")
